body:
New server/zone/grid.go: CellFor/CenterOf, FFXI-style I-7 labels, real per-zone bounds grounded in actual spawn positions from server/mob's own *Spawns() functions. 7 new tests, go test ./... clean. Commit c634361. Phase 2 (data-driven spawn tables) is next; card stays open across its 5 phases per MOB_SPAWN_NORTHSTAR.md.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD-MOBSPAWN-001 Phase 1 shipped: real zone grid coordinate system
